description: Decision-shaped SSRF-safe spot-check of a public URL for an x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED / 402 challenge. Returns only verdict (pay|skip|recheck), reason, quoted_price_usd, claimed_price_usd, and access. Never pays the target (probe GET only). 1 free check per client per UTC day (client=vc-mcp), then $0.01 to $0.25 USDC (one tenth of the target's quoted price) on Base via x402. Unpaid after free quota: payment instructions. Forward PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for a paid check.

claimed_price.description: optional claimed USD price to compare vs quoted

task.description: optional task label (ignored in decision output)

name: endpoint_spot_check
